payload.body: You tend to recognize a need before it becomes a full argument, but you do not always say it right away. A quiet text, a change of plan, or a direct request can prevent other people from having to guess why you seem different. You may hesitate because care once felt safer when it was offered without asking. Make the small request while the answer can still be simple.
